title: 第一卷 第24章 巧杀妖兽，独取灵果
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
腥风阵阵，凶戾之气弥漫林间。

    透过枝叶缝隙往前望去，前方一片开阔的林间空地上，一头身形矫健的巨型妖兽正盘踞在地。

    通体漆黑皮毛泛着哑光光泽，脊背排列一排森白骨刺，四肢肌肉虬结，充满爆发力量，一双竖瞳幽绿发亮，透着残暴嗜血之意。

    正是青峦秘境中层的高阶凶兽——黑脊裂风豹。

    此豹速度极快，擅长隐匿突袭、近身搏杀，肉身防御强悍，利爪可轻易撕裂低层法器，真实修为已然抵达炼气七层，战力远超同阶修士。

    此刻，这头裂风豹正来回踱步，死死守护着身前一株三尺灵木。

    灵木青翠欲滴，灵气萦绕枝头，顶端悬挂三枚通透淡青果实，清香淡雅，沁人心脾。

    是难得的清风灵果。

    此类灵果专攻净化灵力杂质、梳理周身经脉、加速悟道感悟，对炼气修士而言，价值极高。

    尤其是对于常年厮杀、灵力驳杂、经脉留有细微隐患的修士，效果绝佳。

    裂风豹显然早已在此驻守多时，将这株灵木视作自己专属机缘，半点不容外物靠近。

    苏玄尘隐于树后，静静观察局势，不急不躁。

    七层妖兽，正面硬拼极为耗费灵力，甚至有可能被利爪所伤。

    他修为仅有炼气四层不到，肉身虽经古卷滋养远超表象，却也绝不鲁莽逞强。

    百年沉浮，他早已深谙秘境生存之道——强者静待时机，弱者盲目争锋。
content_en:
There were bursts of fishy wind, and the ferocious atmosphere filled the forest.

    Looking forward through the gaps between the branches and leaves, in an open forest clearing ahead, a giant monster beast with a strong body is entrenched on the ground.

    The jet black fur on the whole body has a matte sheen, and there is a row of white bone spurs on the back. The muscles of the limbs are knotted, full of explosive power, and a pair of vertical pupils are green and shiny, revealing a cruel and bloodthirsty meaning.

    It is the high-level ferocious beast in the middle level of Qingluan Secret Realm - the Black-spine Split Wind Leopard.

    This leopard is extremely fast and is good at stealth raids and close combat. It has strong physical defense and its sharp claws can easily tear apart low-level magic weapons. Its true cultivation level has reached the seventh level of Qi refining, and its combat power far exceeds that of monks of the same level.

    At this moment, the Wind-Splitting Leopard was pacing back and forth, guarding a three-foot spiritual tree in front of him.

    The spiritual tree is verdant, with aura lingering on the branches, and three transparent light green fruits hanging from the top. The fragrance is light and elegant, refreshing.

    It is a rare Qingfeng spirit fruit.

    This type of spiritual fruit specializes in purifying spiritual impurities, sorting out the meridians throughout the body, and accelerating enlightenment. It is extremely valuable to Qi refining monks.

    Especially for monks who have been fighting all year round, have mixed spiritual powers, and have subtle hidden dangers in their meridians, the effect is excellent.

    The Split Wind Leopard has obviously been stationed here for a long time. He regards this spiritual tree as his own exclusive opportunity and does not allow outsiders to approach it.

    Su Xuanchen hid behind a tree, quietly observing the situation without being impatient.

    For a seventh-level monster, fighting head-on consumes spiritual energy, and may even be injured by sharp claws.

    His cultivation level is less than the fourth level of Qi Refining. Although his body is nourished by ancient scrolls and is much better than it appears, he is never reckless and aggressive.

    After a hundred years of ups and downs, he has long understood the way to survive in the secret realm - the strong wait for the opportunity, while the weak fight blindly.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 24 Kill the monsters skillfully and get the spiritual fruit alone
